fcdo.title: UK Government foreign travel advice (Open Government Licence v3.0)

entry.en: Your passport must have an expiry date at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area.
entry.es: Tu pasaporte debe tener una fecha de vencimiento al menos 3 meses después del día en que planeas salir del espacio Schengen.
entry.quote: have an ‘expiry date’ at least 3 months after the day you plan to leave the Schengen area

entry.en: At Danish border control you may need to show a return or onward ticket.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo danés puede que te pidan mostrar un billete de vuelta o de continuación.
entry.quote: show a return or onward ticket

entry.en: At Danish border control you may also need to prove that you have enough money for your stay.
entry.es: En el control fronterizo danés puede que también debas demostrar que tienes dinero suficiente para tu estancia.
entry.quote: prove that you have enough money for your stay – the amount varies depending on your accommodation

entry.en: You must declare cash or travellers cheques worth 10,000 euros or more.
entry.es: Debes declarar efectivo o cheques de viajero por un valor de 10.000 euros o más.
entry.quote: Declare cash or travellers cheques if the value is 10,000 euros or more.

entry.en: When entering the Schengen area for short stays you may need to register biometric details such as fingerprints and a photo.
entry.es: Al entrar al espacio Schengen para estancias cortas puede que debas registrar datos biométricos como huellas y una foto.
entry.quote: when you travel into the Schengen area for short stays, you may need to register your biometric details, such as fingerprints and a photo

entry.en: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.
entry.es: No puedes llevar carne, leche ni productos que los contengan a los países de la UE.
entry.quote: You cannot take meat, milk or products containing them into EU countries.

safety.en: Crime levels are generally low, but pickpockets and bag-snatchers operate in crowded areas, mainly in Copenhagen.
safety.es: El nivel de delincuencia es en general bajo, pero hay carteristas y ladrones de bolsos en zonas concurridas, sobre todo en Copenhague.
safety.quote: Crime levels are generally low, but pickpockets and bag-snatchers operate in crowded areas, mainly in Copenhagen.

safety.en: Take extra care in Christiania and Nørrebro, particularly late at night, where there have been some instances of gang violence.
safety.es: Ten especial cuidado en Christiania y Nørrebro, sobre todo a altas horas de la noche, donde ha habido algunos casos de violencia entre bandas.
safety.quote: Take extra care in Christiania and Nørrebro, particularly late at night. There have been some instances of gang violence in these areas.

safety.en: Terrorist attacks in Denmark cannot be ruled out.
safety.es: No se pueden descartar atentados terroristas en Dinamarca.
safety.quote: Terrorist attacks in Denmark cannot be ruled out.

safety.en: It is illegal to wear clothing that conceals your face in a public place in Denmark.
safety.es: Es ilegal llevar ropa que oculte el rostro en un lugar público en Dinamarca.
safety.quote: It’s illegal to wear clothing that conceals your face in a public place in Denmark.

safety.en: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, are strictly prohibited, even in small quantities.
safety.es: Las drogas ilegales, incluido el cannabis, están estrictamente prohibidas, incluso en pequeñas cantidades.
safety.quote: Illegal drugs, including cannabis, are strictly prohibited, even in small quantities.

safety.en: Cyclists often have the right of way, so check cycle lanes before turning right.
safety.es: Los ciclistas suelen tener preferencia, así que revisa los carriles bici antes de girar a la derecha.
safety.quote: Cyclists often have the right of way. Always check cycle lanes before turning right.

health.en: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Denmark you need a GHIC or an EHIC.
health.es: Para recibir la atención médica estatal necesaria en Dinamarca se necesita una tarjeta GHIC o EHIC.
health.quote: To get medically necessary state healthcare in Denmark, you need a Global Health Insurance Card (GHIC) or a European Health Insurance Card (EHIC).

health.en: Denmark does not recognise UK prescriptions, so for medication you should speak to a local pharmacist.
health.es: Dinamarca no reconoce las recetas del Reino Unido, así que para medicamentos conviene hablar con un farmacéutico local.
health.quote: Denmark does not recognise UK prescriptions. If you need medication, you should speak to a local pharmacist (‘Apotek’)

health.en: Tap water is potable unless indicated, which is very rare.
health.es: El agua del grifo es potable salvo que se indique lo contrario, lo cual es muy raro.
health.quote: Tap water is potable unless indicated, which is very rare indeed.

health.en: All visitors are provided with free emergency care until they are deemed healthy enough to be transported home.
health.es: Todos los visitantes reciben atención de urgencia gratuita hasta que se considera que pueden ser trasladados a su país.
health.quote: All visitors are provided with free emergency care, until you are deemed healthy enough to be transported back to your home country.

health.en: Borrelia-carrying ticks are on the rise in Denmark, so check your body for them after being in the wild.
health.es: Las garrapatas que portan borrelia van en aumento en Dinamarca, así que revisa tu cuerpo tras estar en el campo.
health.quote: borrelia-carrying ticks have also been on the rise in Denmark. Always check your body for them when you have been in the wild

health.en: You should have travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation.
health.es: Debes tener un seguro de viaje que cubra tratamiento local o una evacuación médica inesperada.
health.quote: you have appropriate travel insurance for local treatment or unexpected medical evacuation

help.en: The emergency number in Denmark is 112 for ambulance, fire and police.
help.es: El número de emergencias en Dinamarca es el 112 para ambulancia, bomberos y policía.

help.en: For the police in non-emergencies you can call 114.
help.es: Para la policía en situaciones que no son emergencias puedes llamar al 114.
help.quote: For the police in non-emergencies call 1-1-4 (Service 114).

help.en: Contact your travel provider and insurer if you are involved in a serious incident or emergency abroad.
help.es: Contacta con tu agencia de viajes y tu aseguradora si te ves envuelto en un incidente grave o una emergencia en el extranjero.
help.quote: Contact your travel provider and your insurer if you are involved in a serious incident or emergency abroad.

help.en: Lost or found property should be claimed or handed in with the police.
help.es: Los objetos perdidos o encontrados deben reclamarse o entregarse en la policía.
help.quote: the belonging must be claimed or handed in with the Police

help.en: To claim compensation for serious criminal injuries you must report the incident to police within 24 hours.
help.es: Para reclamar una indemnización por lesiones penales graves debes denunciar el hecho a la policía en un plazo de 24 horas.
help.quote: If you wish to file a claim you must report the incident to police within 24 hours

getting_in.en: Copenhagen Airport (CPH) is the largest airport in Scandinavia.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Copenhague (CPH) es el más grande de Escandinavia.
getting_in.quote: Copenhagen Airport (CPH IATA) is the largest airport in Scandinavia.

getting_in.en: Copenhagen Airport is connected by train to Copenhagen Central Station and to Malmö and other towns in Sweden.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Copenhague está conectado por tren con la estación central de Copenhague y con Malmö y otras ciudades de Suecia.
getting_in.quote: The airport is connected by train to Copenhagen Central Station and beyond, Malmö and other towns in Sweden.

getting_in.en: Billund Airport (BLL) is Denmark's 2nd largest airport and the main airport for the entire Jutland peninsula.
getting_in.es: El aeropuerto de Billund (BLL) es el segundo más grande de Dinamarca y el principal de toda la península de Jutlandia.
getting_in.quote: Billund Airport (BLL IATA) in South-Central Jutland is Denmark's 2nd largest airport, and the main airport for the entire peninsula.

getting_in.en: There are frequent ferry connections to Norway, with Hirtshals as the busiest port.
getting_in.es: Hay frecuentes conexiones en ferry con Noruega, y Hirtshals es el puerto más activo.
getting_in.quote: This has ensured frequent ferry connections to Norway, with the busiest port being Hirtshals

getting_in.en: EuroCity trains run between Hamburg and Copenhagen up to 8 times daily.
getting_in.es: Los trenes EuroCity circulan entre Hamburgo y Copenhague hasta 8 veces al día.
getting_in.quote: EuroCity trains run between Hamburg and Copenhagen up to 8 times daily.

getting_in.en: From Sweden you can drive to Copenhagen over the Øresund bridge, which costs 325 kr.
getting_in.es: Desde Suecia se puede conducir a Copenhague por el puente de Øresund, que cuesta 325 kr.
getting_in.quote: From Sweden, catch route E20 from Gothenburg (312 km) or E4 from Stockholm (655 km) to Malmö and connect with the Øresund bridge (325 kr).

getting_around.en: For trains, buses and ferries you can use the online travel planner Rejseplanen.
getting_around.es: Para trenes, autobuses y ferris puedes usar el planificador de viajes en línea Rejseplanen.
getting_around.quote: For public transportation (trains, buses and ferries) use the online travel planner Rejseplanen.

getting_around.en: Train tickets must be bought before boarding, as fare inspectors check them and tickets are not sold on board.
getting_around.es: Los billetes de tren deben comprarse antes de subir, ya que los revisores los controlan y no se venden a bordo.
getting_around.quote: All passengers must have tickets or passes purchased prior to boarding the train; fare inspectors check tickets, and tickets are not sold on board.

getting_around.en: The Rejsekort card costs a non-refundable 80 kr, and its balance must be at least 70 kr when you start a trip.
getting_around.es: La tarjeta Rejsekort cuesta 80 kr no reembolsables y su saldo debe ser de al menos 70 kr al iniciar un viaje.
getting_around.quote: The card costs 80 kr which is not refundable, and the balance on the card must be at least 70 kr when you start a trip

getting_around.en: Ride-share services like Uber were not legal in Denmark as of 2023.
getting_around.es: Los servicios de viajes compartidos como Uber no eran legales en Dinamarca en 2023.
getting_around.quote: As of 2023, ride-share services like Uber are not legal in Denmark.

getting_around.en: In cities bicycles always have right of way, especially when turning across bicycle lanes.
getting_around.es: En las ciudades las bicicletas siempre tienen preferencia, sobre todo al girar cruzando carriles bici.
getting_around.quote: Watch out for the bicycles in the cities, especially when turning across bicycle lanes, the bicycles always have right of way.

getting_around.en: Unless otherwise posted, speed limits are 130 km/h on motorways, 80 km/h outside built-up areas and 50 km/h in built-up areas.
getting_around.es: Salvo indicación contraria, los límites son 130 km/h en autopistas, 80 km/h fuera de zonas urbanas y 50 km/h en zonas urbanas.
getting_around.quote: Unless otherwise posted, speed limits are 130 km/h (80 mph) on the motorways, 80 km/h (50 mph) outside build-up areas and 50 km/h (30 mph) in build-up areas.

money.en: The national currency is the Danish krone (DKK).
money.es: La moneda nacional es la corona danesa (DKK).
money.quote: The national currency is the Danish krone (plural "kroner", abbreviated "kr", ISO code: DKK).

money.en: Some retailers, particularly supermarkets, may add a 3% to 4% surcharge if you pay with a foreign credit card.
money.es: Algunos comercios, sobre todo supermercados, pueden añadir un recargo del 3% al 4% si pagas con una tarjeta de crédito extranjera.
money.quote: some retailers, particularly supermarkets, may add a 3% to 4% transaction surcharge if you pay with a foreign credit card

money.en: Retailers in Denmark have the right to refuse cash payments from 20:00 to 06:00.
money.es: Los comercios en Dinamarca tienen derecho a rechazar pagos en efectivo de las 20:00 a las 06:00.
money.quote: Retailers in Denmark have the right to refuse cash payments from 20:00 to 06:00

money.en: Small businesses that cater to locals may only accept MobilePay or cash, so carry a little cash.
money.es: Los pequeños negocios que atienden a locales pueden aceptar solo MobilePay o efectivo, así que lleva algo de efectivo.
money.quote: Small businesses that cater primarily to locals, including small restaurants and vendors at flea markets, may only accept MobilePay or cash. Carry a small amount of cash in case you find yourself in such a situation.

money.en: Consumer sales include a 20% sales tax (Moms), and displayed prices are legally required to include it.
money.es: Las ventas a consumidores incluyen un impuesto del 20% (Moms) y por ley los precios mostrados ya lo incluyen.
money.quote: All consumer sales include a 20% sales tax (Moms) but displayed prices are legally required to include this

money.en: Tipping is neither expected nor required, even for professional and trained attendants.
money.es: La propina no se espera ni se exige, ni siquiera para personal profesional y capacitado.
money.quote: tipping is neither expected nor required, and that goes for professional and trained attendants as well

etiquette.en: Being punctual matters, as few things annoy Danes more than showing up late, even by minutes.
etiquette.es: La puntualidad importa, pues pocas cosas molestan más a los daneses que llegar tarde, aunque sea por minutos.
etiquette.quote: Be punctual; few things can make the Danes more annoyed than showing up late, even by minutes

etiquette.en: Respect Danes' personal space and do not touch or back-slap someone you are not well acquainted with.
etiquette.es: Respeta el espacio personal de los daneses y no toques ni des palmadas en la espalda a quien no conozcas bien.
etiquette.quote: Respect the personal space of Danes. Do not touch or back-slap someone you're not well acquainted with.

etiquette.en: Good friends often greet with a careful hug, and a handshake is customary for everyone else.
etiquette.es: Los buenos amigos suelen saludarse con un abrazo cuidadoso y para los demás es habitual el apretón de manos.
etiquette.quote: Greetings between good friends, close relatives, etc. are often in the form of a careful hug. A handshake is customary for everyone else.

etiquette.en: Each train has marked quiet zones at the back of the back wagon and the front of the front wagon.
etiquette.es: Cada tren tiene zonas de silencio señalizadas al final del último vagón y al inicio del primero.
etiquette.quote: Be aware that there are marked "quiet zones" on each train: one in the back of the back wagon and one in the front of the front wagon.

etiquette.en: When visiting a Dane's home, bringing a small gift such as chocolate, flowers or wine is common.
etiquette.es: Al visitar la casa de un danés es habitual llevar un pequeño regalo como chocolate, flores o vino.
etiquette.quote: Bring a small gift; chocolate, flowers or wine are the most common.

etiquette.en: Outside places of worship, displays of faith should be kept private.
etiquette.es: Fuera de los lugares de culto, las muestras de fe deben mantenerse en privado.
etiquette.quote: Outside places of worship, displays of faith should be kept private.

connectivity.en: Major network operators have stopped selling prepaid service themselves, leaving it to two MVNOs, Lebara and Lycamobile.
connectivity.es: Los principales operadores han dejado de vender prepago y lo han dejado en manos de dos OMV, Lebara y Lycamobile.
connectivity.quote: All of the major network operators in Denmark have stopped selling prepaid service themselves, instead leaving the prepaid market to the two MVNOs listed above.

connectivity.en: You should bring your own unlocked 4G/LTE phone, since there is no longer a 3G/UMTS operator in Denmark.
connectivity.es: Debes traer tu propio teléfono 4G/LTE liberado, ya que en Dinamarca ya no hay operador 3G/UMTS.
connectivity.quote: Since there is no longer a 3G/UMTS operator in Denmark, you should bring your own unlocked 4G/LTE phone to make calls.

connectivity.en: With an EU-based mobile subscription you should be able to use at least some of your minutes, SMS and data in Denmark at no extra cost.
connectivity.es: Con una suscripción móvil de la UE deberías poder usar al menos parte de tus minutos, SMS y datos en Dinamarca sin coste extra.
connectivity.quote: If you have an existing subscription with an EU-based mobile provider, you should be able to use at least some of your bundled minutes, SMS, and data in Denmark at no extra cost.

connectivity.en: Many cafés and bars provide free wireless internet to paying customers, even when it is not signposted.
connectivity.es: Muchos cafés y bares ofrecen wifi gratis a los clientes, incluso cuando no está señalizado.
connectivity.quote: Many cafés and bars also provide free wireless internet for paying customers, even when it is not signposted

connectivity.en: The easiest way to get online is often the public library, which is always free.
connectivity.es: La forma más fácil de conectarse suele ser la biblioteca pública, que siempre es gratuita.
connectivity.quote: The easiest way to get online is often the public library, as there is one in almost every town.

connectivity.en: Denmark's international phone country code is 45.
connectivity.es: El prefijo telefónico internacional de Dinamarca es el 45.
connectivity.quote: Denmark's international phone country code is 45.
